reasons: Replay is deterministic and plain-HTTP (no cookies, 200, real JSON, title/deadline/status mapped correctly), but the config pins one year-specific opportunity number. It returns 0 hits once USDA-NIFA-AFRI-011134 closes (closeDate 12/31/2026), so the 'forever' feed goes silent. An agency-wide config returns the same record plus other live NIFA calls and passes the adapter check.
issues: Stability: adapter_config.oppNum is a single RFA identifier. Once it closes (closeDate 12/31/2026) or a successor RFA is posted, the query returns 0 hits and the edge function reports 'parsed 0 opportunities'. Not forever-proof.
Control: a bogus oppNum (USDA-NIFA-ZZZZ-000000) returns hitCount 0, so the filter is exact-match and not a silent fallback to all records.
Replay x2: adapter_check run twice 20 s apart returned identical output (ok=true, count=1, http=200, bytes=1641).

Plain HTTP: curl POST to https://api.grants.gov/v1/api/search2 with only a plain User-Agent and an empty cookie jar returned HTTP 200, errorcode 0, hitCount 1. The 'token' field is a per-response value that the adapter does not send back, so it is not a request dependency.
Error pages: no bot challenge or HTML error page observed; errorcode 0 'Webservice Succeeds' on both runs.

Field mapping: external_id=USDA-NIFA-AFRI-011134 (number, unique and stable), title non-empty, deadline 2026-12-31 from closeDate, status open from oppStatus posted, url grants.gov/search-results-detail/360205 returned HTTP 200 (34856 bytes).
Deadline sanity: closeDate 12/31/2026 is in the future relative to 2026-11-11, so the row is live today.

Recommended fix (not applied, verify before adopting): adapter_config {"agencies":"USDA-NIFA","rows":25,"oppStatuses":"forecasted|posted"}. adapter_check returned ok=true, count=5, http=200, including USDA-NIFA-AFRI-011134 (deadline 2026-12-31). This keeps the program alive when the specific RFA changes. A keyword 'AFRI' filter would be narrower but is loose and not a filter per the engine notes.

Scope note: the funder row's current adapter is html (the simpler.grants.gov opportunity page). Switching to grants_gov changes monitoring to structured rows, which is the intent here, but the candidate should be re-checked after the agency-wide change.
